lead: Neither a tree-wide `python tools/dossier.py --gate` nor `--owed` will tell you a figure is stale.
body: The gate prints only its first 30 owing features (`missing[:30]`) out of the hundreds the feature-proofs program still owes, and `--owed` prints each row's proof *names* with the reason dropped, so a stale figure reads exactly like a feature with no bench at all. Ask per group — `python tools/dossier.py --gate --group 'Core\Db\Write'` — or per feature with `--id`, and pick the groups from the files your own commits touched, since a figure is keyed on its implementing file's text.
